summary.lv: Mintos meklē Senior Android inženieri, kurš veidos mērogojamu Android lietotni FinTech platformai ar miljoniem investoru visā Eiropā, strādājot pie maksājumu infrastruktūras un dalīto komponentu uzlabošanas.
summary.en: Mintos is looking for a Senior Android Engineer to build a scalable, high-quality Android experience for their FinTech platform serving millions of investors across Europe, focusing on payment infrastructure and shared engineering components.
